notes.title: Pie in the Sky - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.notes:
Monster Shop Games is extremely excited to announce that they have partnered up with indie.io to publish Pie in the Sky!

Making a game as a solo developer or small company is a huge undertaking and with the help of indie.io, Pie in the Sky will now be able to reach a much larger audience and achieve the quality of content that the audience deserves.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates on Pie in the Sky as it joins the amazing catalogue of indie.io published games!

notes.title: Pie in the Sky - DEMO!
notes.notes:
Pie in the Sky Demo Live Now!

That's right! You can now try the game for free by downloading the demo!

The demo version includes:
- 3 levels with the majority of their objectives
- a preview of some of the original music tracks that will be in the game
- 3 skins to unlock for your magpie
- 3 hidden accessories to find for your magpie

Please note that the game is still early in development and is subject to change.
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/QvfZYqH5v8]Discord[/url] to submit feedback or bug reports or to just have a yarn with the developer!

Have fun!

notes.title: Pie in the Sky - SXSW Sydney 2024 Games Festival!
notes.notes:
Very happy to announce that Pie in the Sky has been chosen for the official SXSW Sydney 2024 Games Festival!

If you're at the event, come and give it a try for its first official public display!
